summary: Adds one row after the last row that holds data.
description: A sheet is examined whole and the row is written from column 1; a range is examined only inside itself and the row is written on its columns, below the last row of the range that holds data.
It is `appendRows` with one row: the same guards, the same growth of the sheet when the result would not fit, and the same rule that a cell whose text starts with `=` becomes a formula.

params.target: The sheet to append to, or the range to append within.
params.values: A single row: a flat array, one value per column.
params.options: `afterFrozenRows` starts the write below the frozen rows when the data ends before them.

returns: the sheet, so calls can be chained.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is neither a sheet nor a range.
throws.TypeError: the values are not a flat array.
